body:
Execute Ticket 5 (t-run2-w5-skills-scripts) for Release Audit Run 2.

IMPORTANT HEADLESS WORKER RULES:
- Use ONLY view_file, replace_file_content, and write_to_file.
- Do NOT call run_command (the scheduler automatically runs the test suite in the gating phase immediately after you finish editing).
- Only edit files in your declared scope (npm run skills:sync will mirror skills/** into .claude/skills/** and .agents/skills/** after the fleet run).

1. In skills/modernize/scripts/audit.mjs (SHOULD-FIX #5, #6, #14 & BACKLOG #10):
   - SHOULD-FIX #5 (Stage 5 offline manifest fallback vs upstream changelog, lines 817-834 & 1015-1035):
     * Track let adlcProvenanceSource = ADLC_CHANGELOG_URL;
     * When fetchText(ADLC_CHANGELOG_URL) fails and !process.env.ADLC_CHANGELOG_URL && fs.existsSync(localAdlcManifest):
       Parse const localManifestObj = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(localAdlcManifest, 'utf8'));
       Verify if (localManifestObj.version !== TARGET_ADLC_VERSION) throw new Error(`FATAL: Local vendored ADLC manifest version (${localManifestObj.version}) does not match target ADLC version (${TARGET_ADLC_VERSION})`);
       Set adlcContent = fs.readFileSync(localAdlcManifest, 'utf8'); and adlcProvenanceSource = 'local:vendor/adlc/package.json';
     * In committedRecord, include adlcProvenanceSource (and keep adlcChangelogUrl: adlcProvenanceSource) so offline manifest fallback is distinguished from upstream changelog verification while keeping offline npm test green.
   - SHOULD-FIX #6 (Windows spawn portability, lines 385-415 & 839-845):
     * Add shell: process.platform === 'win32' to Stage 1 cp.spawnSync(agyBin, ...) calls and Stage 5 cp.execFileSync('npm', ['pack', ...], { ..., shell: process.platform === 'win32' }).
   - SHOULD-FIX #14 (Stage 4 validatePlan import fallback when devDependencies are absent, lines 709-715):
     * Wrap await import(planMjsUrl) in try/catch; if importing lib/plan.mjs fails (e.g. ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND when @adlc/core is absent), fall back to an inline structural validator validatePlanFallback(plan) that checks plan.repo, plan.gate, non-empty plan.tickets, unique valid ticket IDs, non-empty body and scope, valid tier, and valid edges.
   - BACKLOG #10 (Stage 2 runStage2StaticAudit, lines 530-537):
     * Verify that @adlc/core and @adlc/antigravity are declared in package.json (devDeps or deps), pushing a finding into auditFindings if missing.

2. In scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs (SHOULD-FIX #12):
   - At line 25, change CALL_PATTERN to:
     const CALL_PATTERN = /\b(?:import|(?:__)?require\d*(?:\s*\.\s*resolve)?)\s*\(([^)]+)\)/g;
   - At line 70, change if (/^require\d*$/.test(ident)) continue; to:
     if (/^(?:__)?require\d*$/.test(ident)) continue;

3. In scripts/update-adlc-digests.mjs (BACKLOG #8 & #9):
   - In verifyAgainstLockfile (around lines 50-55), also parse join(unpackedPkgDir, 'package.json') and join(localDir, 'package.json') and compare their name, version, main, bin, and exports fields (JSON.stringify), returning { ok: false, error: `${pkg}@${entry.version}: package.json manifest mismatch` } if any differ.
   - In computeVendoredDigests (lines 63-71), verify typeof manifest.version === 'string' && manifest.version.trim().length > 0 (throwing an Error if missing), and in main() verify digests.version matches the lockfile version of @adlc/core when package-lock.json exists.

4. In skills/release-audit/SKILL.md and skills/release/SKILL.md (SHOULD-FIX #13 & BACKLOG #11):
   - Prefix the frontmatter description in skills/release-audit/SKILL.md and skills/release/SKILL.md with "[Maintainer workflow for the antigravity-booster repository only] ".
   - In skills/release-audit/SKILL.md (around line 202), clarify that the helper scripts in scripts/ live in the antigravity-booster source repository checkout.
   - In skills/release/SKILL.md Step 2 (around line 61), add npm run build and git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all dist/ vendor/ verification right after npm test.

5. Add unit tests at the end of test/check-bundle-externals.test.mjs and test/update-adlc-digests.test.mjs covering the changes above.
title: Fix modernize audit script provenance/Windows/devDep handling, check-bundle-externals __require regex, update-adlc-digests checks, and release/release-audit skill docs
